title: Upload your products
lead: One image and a name per product is enough. A photo with a clearly visible label gives the best result.

aside.label: Selected template
aside.promise: The structure stays the same: shots, order, timing and on-screen text. People, setting and music are made new around your product.
aside.presenterNote: What the presenter says is written from your product description. Only claims you typed are used.
